sentences.en: In high school, Naomi Rothman was a shy teenager.

sentences.en: That is, until she laced up her cleats and stepped on the field for her travel soccer team.
sentences.zh: 直到她系好鞋带，踏上旅行足球队的赛场。

sentences.en: Surrounded by teammates she loved, Naomi became a completely different person.
sentences.zh: 在心爱的队友簇拥下，娜奥米变成了一个完全不同的人。

sentences.en: We were called the Red Hot Chili Peppers, and it was very meaningful to me
sentences.zh: 我们队叫“红辣椒”，这对我很重要，

sentences.en: because I created these really strong friendships, and it gave me a lot of confidence.
sentences.zh: 因为我结交了非常深厚的友谊，这给了我很多自信。

sentences.en: It gave me a sense of self-worth and self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 它让我有了自我价值感和自尊心。

sentences.en: And I really strongly identified with this team.
sentences.zh: 我对自己所在的这支球队有着强烈的认同感。

sentences.en: The players on this team predominantly came from the east side of town and played at Harbor High.
sentences.zh: 队里的球员大多来自城东，就读于港口高中。

sentences.en: Naomi's school, Santa Cruz High, was on the west side of our hometown of Santa Cruz, California.
sentences.zh: 而娜奥米的学校——圣克鲁斯高中，位于我们家乡加州圣克鲁斯的西区。

sentences.en: And so during our high school season, we had to play against each other,

sentences.en: and someone always had to lose.
Harbor and Santa Cruz were always among the top contenders.
sentences.zh: 港口高中和圣克鲁斯高中一直是顶尖的竞争对手。

sentences.en: The rivalry between the schools was intense.

sentences.en: Every game we played against one another was high stakes,
sentences.zh: 我们之间的每一场比赛都关乎重大，

sentences.en: and these games were some of the most emotionally fraught games that I ever played.
sentences.zh: 这些比赛是我打过最令人情绪紧绷的比赛之一。

sentences.en: And the reason was that I loved these players.
I had this deep, genuine affection for the people that I was trying to beat.
